mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, the temperature is 49 degrees under overcast skies near Harriet Park, with the waning crescent moon hidden above. The overnight low will reach 47 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is updating residents on the permit process for stormwater management and erosion control, requiring pre-application meetings for new projects. Additionally, we are welcoming EMS Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the city administration.
There is plenty to do this week, including live music at Paddy Mac's today, yoga at Insight Wellness today, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory tomorrow.

Regarding the weekly report, on October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was found unresponsive in his vehicle.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the night. Tomorrow, be sure to stop by when they open at 10:00 AM to enjoy the flavor of the day, which is Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
